table inet filter {
	set lan_tcp {
		type inet_service
		elements = { 22, 80 }
	}

	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state established,related accept
		iif "lo" accept
		ip saddr 192.168.1.0/24 tcp dport 7519 accept
		meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport { 5353, 7000-7600 } accept
		ip6 nexthdr icmpv6 accept
		tcp dport 9000 drop
	}

	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
	}

	chain output {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
	}
}
